from pathlib import Path
import json,re
prod=Path.home()/"prediction_research_prod"
aliases={
"ASSET-RANK-MAKER-HEDGE-V1":"AR",
"AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d":"AD",
"KWI-FULL-STATION-PRECANONICAL-V1":"KF",
"KWI-INCOMPLETE-TO-CANONICAL-V1":"KI",
"MANUAL-SCOUT-HENGELTJES-20260924":"H",
"PAYOFF-IDENTITY-MINING-V1":"PI",
}
vals={}
cand=prod/"knowledge/candidates"
count=0
if cand.is_dir():
  for p in cand.glob("*.json"):
    try:
      d=json.loads(p.read_text())
    except Exception:
      continue
    cid=d.get("candidate_id")
    if cid: count+=1
    if cid in aliases: vals[aliases[cid]]=d.get("queue_status") or d.get("phase") or "?"
# YAML active
act=prod/"candidates/active"
for fname,alias in [("KAL-WX-INDEX-001.yaml","KW"),("PM-NR-V2-CONVERT-001.yaml","PM")]:
  p=act/fname
  if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
    t=p.read_text(errors="replace")
    m=re.search(r"(?m)^\s*(?:status|queue_status):\s*[\"']?([^\"'\n#]+)",t)
    vals[alias]=m.group(1).strip() if m else "?"
# supervisor
sup="?"
sp=prod/"knowledge/codex_runtime/STATE.json"
if sp.is_file() and not sp.is_symlink():
  try: sup=json.loads(sp.read_text()).get("state") or "?"
  except Exception: pass
# qualification stages
q=[]
qp=Path("/tmp/prediction-full-a2z-live-v4-state.json")
if qp.is_file() and not qp.is_symlink():
  try:
    for s in json.loads(qp.read_text()).get("stages",[]):
      q.append((s.get("stage") or "?")+":"+((s.get("status") or "?")[:1]))
  except Exception: pass
order=["AR","AD","H","PI","KF","KI","KW","PM"]
msg="C="+str(count)+";"+";".join(a+"="+str(vals.get(a,"MISSING")) for a in order)+";SUP="+sup+";Q="+",".join(q[-6:])
print("INV4 "+msg,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(2)
